use default

is_prime(value: int) -> bool =>
    value > 1 /\ ((2..value)
        |> take_while(divisor => divisor * divisor <= value)
        |> all(divisor => value % divisor != 0))

divides_repunit(value: int) -> bool =>

        (1..value)
            |> reduce(0, (running, _) => (running * 10 + 1) % value) in

let deceptive =

        |> filter(candidate => candidate % 2 != 0 /\ candidate % 5 != 0)

use default

is_prime(value: int) -> bool =>
    value > 1 /\ ((2..value)
        |> take_while(divisor => divisor * divisor <= value)
        |> all(divisor => value % divisor != 0))

divides_repunit(value: int) -> bool =>
    let remainder =
        (1..value)
            |> reduce(0, (running, _) => (running * 10 + 1) % value) in
    remainder == 0

let deceptive =
    from(7)
        |> filter(candidate => candidate % 2 != 0 /\ candidate % 5 != 0)
        |> filter(candidate => !is_prime(candidate))
        |> filter(divides_repunit)

write_line("the first 25 deceptive numbers:")

deceptive
    |> take(25)
    |> chunk(5)
    |> each(row =>
        write_line(row |> map(value => "{value,7}") |> join("")))
